To match chrome usage, remove 'using std:string' and use std:string throughout. Remove <string> when not used. UPSTREAM: netfilter: Set /proc/net entries owner to root in namespace Various files are owned by root with 0440 permission. Reading them is impossible in an unprivileged user namespace, interfering with firewall tools. For instance, iptables-save relies on /proc/net/ip_tables_names contents to dump only loaded tables. This patch assigned ownership of the following files to root in the current namespace: - /proc/net/*_tables_names - /proc/net/*_tables_matches - /proc/net/*_tables_targets - /proc/net/nf_conntrack - /proc/net/nf_conntrack_expect - /proc/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log A mapping for root must be available, so this order should be followed: unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER); /* Setup the mapping */ unshare(CLONE_NEWNET); Signed-off-by: Philip Whineray <phil@firehol.org> Signed-off-by: Pablo Neira Ayuso <pablo@netfilter.org> (cherry picked from kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git commit f13f2aeed154da8e48f90b85e720f8ba39b1e881) Signed-off-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@google.com> BUG=b:29192551 TEST=/system/bin/iptables-{save,restore} inside the container work Change-Id: Idf4ff41b316533af69070bbd8b0b093fffe8de3a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/354270 Commit-Ready: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Tested-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kevin Cernekee <cernekee@chromium.org>
